basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old graphic designer living in Toronto, Canada. I recently discovered Reddit and am enjoying exploring different communities. My interests include sci-fi TV shows, gaming, and learning about different cultures. I work freelance, so my online hours are quite flexible. I’m single and love spending my free time playing Minecraft, especially on CubeCraft servers, and watching fan edits of my favorite films and shows.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having studied at a local college. Most of my knowledge has been self-taught through online courses and practice. I'm also a casual gamer and enjoy keeping up with the latest trends in sci-fi shows and movies.
